scenario: Two paths on ext4 mounts whose super options carry no quota key at all: the superblock quota feature is therefore unobservable from mountinfo, so the state is unknown, never disabled.

fixture.mountinfo:
29 1 8:1 / / rw,relatime shared:1 - ext4 /dev/sda1 rw,errors=remount-ro
30 29 0:31 / /home rw,relatime shared:2 - btrfs /dev/mapper/root rw,space_cache=v2,subvolid=5,subvol=/
31 29 8:2 / /srv rw,relatime shared:3 - ext4 /dev/sdb1 rw,errors=remount-ro

rationale: Contract table row (contract.md line 119: ext2/ext3/ext4 | none of quota,usrquota,grpquota,prjquota,usrjquota,grpjquota | unknown | n/a | ext_quota_superblock_unobservable); its first arm (line 118) cannot fire here. Both paths land on ext4 mounts whose super options (the last mountinfo field; proc.rst S082 section 3.5 field (m+4), lines 1982-1983) contain only rw and errors=remount-ro, so no quota key is present and the second arm gives quota_state=unknown, enforcement=n/a, basis=ext_quota_superblock_unobservable. Unknown (not disabled) is the honest reading: ext4.rst S083 lines 261-265 state that the quota/noquota/grpquota/usrquota options are ignored by the filesystem and are used only by quota tools to recognize volumes where quota should be turned on, so a mount without those options does not prove the superblock quota feature is off; the contract's own limits text records that the ext quota feature in the superblock is unobservable without privileged tools. Mount resolution (contract.md lines 95-99): candidate mounts are those whose mount point equals the realpath, is /, or is a prefix of the realpath, and the longest mount point wins, so /srv/data resolves to /srv (length 4) rather than the root mount / (length 1), while /var/log is covered only by /; the btrfs mount at /home covers neither path. Device check (contract.md lines 100-103): for a non-btrfs fstype a major:minor that differs from the path st_dev yields unknown with basis device_mismatch, so each path's st_dev equals its chosen mount's major:minor (8:2 for the /srv mount, 8:1 for the root mount); the btrfs mount at /home is never chosen, so its btrfs_subvolume_skipped device_check never applies. Verdict precedence (contract.md lines 132-135): no path is enabled and at least one path is unknown, so exit 2 with finding_id QUOTA_STATE_UNKNOWN.
